system.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, you know how to manipulate your barrier in a variety of different ways such as generating a Chakra Sphere or Repelling Burst. By spending 1 Superiority die, you can use either of these abilities.

Chakra Sphere. As a reaction, you expand your Chakra Barrier into a 10-foot-radius centered on a point until the start of your next turn. Allied creatures of your choice inside the barrier gains 4 DR. This increases to 8 DR at 9th level and 12 DR at 17th level.

Repelling Burst. As an action, you expand your Chakra Barrier instantly, creating a burst of chakra in a 10-foot radius centered on you. Each creature of your choice within range must make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (Your choice) vs your Ninjutsu Save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Force damage, is pushed back 10 feet and falls prone. On a success, they take half damage and no further effects. This increases to 4d6 at 9th level and 6d6 DR at 17th level.
